production_denominator_rule: Do not use dashboard counts as canonical production-chain count. Extract named chain candidates, normalize identity, deduplicate against current canonical state, then primary-verify lifecycle and execution plane.
limitations: Rendered dashboard is a discovery surface, not a complete machine-readable canonical dataset in this artifact.
Some DEX labels may be protocol/venue names rather than independent chains and require relationship-level classification.
Cross-chain protocols such as Chainflip must not be converted into a chain record merely because they operate across chains.
